decision.question: A key binding's ctrlKey/shiftKey/altKey/metaKey are optional -- what does OMITTED mean: 'must be up' or 'don't care'?
options: omitted = don't care (ignore that modifier when matching)
omitted = that modifier must be UP (exact match, missing read as false)
decision.why: Under 'don't care', a bare "KeyM" binding would also fire every time Ctrl+Shift+M was pressed, so a plain-M action and the Ctrl+Shift+M toggle would both fire off one keypress. Exact matching makes every combination unambiguous. Full reasoning in doc/decisions.md.
